glossary.definition: A recorded event of granted or denied entry to the building.
Registered set of recipients (security officer and building manager roles) who receive each monthly admittance report via the corporate SFTP endpoint.

business_rules.rule: Each monthly admittance report must be deposited to the corporate SFTP endpoint and made available to all recipients on the distribution list within 24 hours of the last calendar day of the covered month; failed deposits must be retried and flagged to the system administrator.
